title.narrative: Contribution to the Climate Action Window (CAW) of the 16th Replenishment of the African Development Fund (AfDF 16)
dt. Beitrag für Klimafenster (CAW) der 16. Wiederauffüllung des Afrikanischen Entwicklungsfonds (AfDF 16)

description.narrative: AfDF 16 will support sustainable and climate-resilient infrastructure investments in the areas Financing agriculture, energy, transport, water and health. At least 40% of the funds should flow into climate financing, of which 50% into climate adaptation.

AfDF 16 wird nachhaltige und klimaresistente Infrastrukturinvestitionen in den Bereichen Landwirtschaft, Energie, Verkehr, Wasser sowie Gesundheit finanzieren. Mindestens 40 % der Mittel sollen in Klimafinanzierung fließen, davon 50 % in Klimaanpassung.
